# Vendored dependencies

## cytoscape.min.js

* Version: 3.30.2
* Source: https://unpkg.com/cytoscape@3.30.2/dist/cytoscape.min.js
* License: MIT (The Cytoscape Consortium)

Committed rather than fetched at build time so `go build` remains the only
build step and the binary stays self-contained. To update, download the new
version and bump the version noted above.
